title: A rational point on the unit circle
caption: The line of slope 1/2 through (−1, 0) meets the circle again at (3/5, 4/5). Both coordinates are fractions, and clearing denominators gives the Pythagorean triple 3, 4, 5.
alt: The unit circle with a line of slope 1/2 from (−1, 0) through (0, 1/2) to the point (3/5, 4/5), and a right triangle with sides 3/5, 4/5 and 1.
description: Start at the point (−1, 0) on the unit circle x² + y² = 1.
Draw the line of slope t = 1/2; it crosses the y-axis at (0, 1/2).
It meets the circle again at (3/5, 4/5), found from x = (1 − t²)/(1 + t²) and y = 2t/(1 + t²).
The right triangle with legs 3/5 and 4/5 and hypotenuse 1 scales to 3, 4, 5.

checks.name: (−1, 0), (0, 1/2) and (3/5, 4/5) are on the line of slope 1/2
